boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's fs_file.c, 0x0205d368..0x0205d8d8: 14 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Each is identified by its body against NitroSDK libraries/fs/common/src/fs_file.c (and pret pokediamond's FS_file.c). FS_Init brings the ROM archive up once behind is_init (FSi_InitRom). FS_InitFile clears the link, queue, arc, command (FS_COMMAND_INVALID, 12) and stat. FSi_FindPath resolves a leading slash or an archive-name prefix (FS_FindArchive, FS_ARCHIVE_NAME_LEN_MAX 3) against current_dir_pos and sends FS_COMMAND_FINDPATH. FSi_ReadFileCore clamps the length to the file and sends FS_COMMAND_READFILE, waiting in FS_WaitAsync unless async. FS_ConvertPathToFileID, FS_OpenFileDirect (FS_COMMAND_OPENFILEDIRECT), FS_OpenFileFast (FS_COMMAND_OPENFILEFAST), FS_OpenFile, FS_CloseFile (FS_COMMAND_CLOSEFILE), FS_GetPathName (FS_COMMAND_GETPATH), FS_WaitAsync, FS_ReadFileAsync, FS_ReadFile and FS_SeekFile follow the SDK step for step.

Order: mwccarm emits the bodies in reverse. The SDK's file order of the surviving functions is FS_Init, FS_InitFile, FSi_FindPath, FSi_ReadFileCore, FS_ConvertPathToFileID, FS_OpenFileDirect, FS_OpenFileFast, FS_OpenFile, FS_CloseFile, FS_GetPathName, FS_WaitAsync, FS_ReadFileAsync, FS_ReadFile, FS_SeekFile, and the ROM holds exactly that reversed. The SDK functions nothing calls (FS_IsAvailable, FS_End, FSi_WriteFileCore, FS_GetPathLength, FS_CancelFile, the write calls and the directory calls) are dead-stripped.
BOTTOM EDGE: FS_SetArchiveProc ends at 0x0205d368, the lowest function of fs_archive.c (arm9/FS_Archive).

TOP EDGE: FSi_AppendToList at 0x0205d8d8. It and FSi_CutFromList (0x0205d8d8..0x0205d94c) are the command-list helpers FS_Archive.cpp and FS_Command.cpp call; no fs_file.c function calls them, so they are left out of this TU.

.bss: is_init (0x020a8058, 4 bytes) is FS_Init's guard, read and written only by FS_Init (config/arm9/relocs.txt). Below it, arc_list (0x020a8048, 4 bytes) and current_dir_pos (0x020a804c, 0xc bytes) are fs_archive.c's: ascending size within that TU, then a drop back to 4 bytes at is_init. Above it, fsi_card_lock_id (0x020a805c) starts fs_rom.c (arm9/FS_Rom).

bss.evidence: The SDK's `static BOOL is_init`: FS_Init tests and sets it before FSi_InitRom. Its only references are FS_Init's (config/arm9/relocs.txt), so the source makes it static; the binding rewrite below publishes it at its configured address.

symbol_binding_rewrites.evidence: file-scope static, as the SDK writes it; dsd cannot record a local symbol in symbols.txt, so the owned object is published global at 0x020a8058
static in the SDK; its only caller is FS_ConvertPathToFileID (0x0205d66c), so it is published global at 0x0205d714 for symbols.txt
static in the SDK; only FS_ReadFile and FS_ReadFileAsync load it (0x0205d3e0, 0x0205d3f0), so it is published global at 0x0205d688 for symbols.txt

notes: HAND-BUILT manifest entry, not tools/tubuild.py create output: tu_map does not segment arm9.
Built as C. The FSFile layout is this SDK's (include/private/fs_views.h); the API is declared once in include/nitro/fs/file.h, which every caller now includes.

The .bss names come from the SDK source: data_020a8058 is is_init, and fs_archive.c's data_020a8048 / data_020a804c are arc_list / current_dir_pos (renamed in config/arm9/symbols.txt and at every declaration).

This SDK is older than pret's: FS_WaitAsync decides ownership by whether the handle heads its archive's command list (pret tests FS_ARCHIVE_FLAG_IS_SYNC), and FS_SeekFile compares the lower bound unsigned.
